name: motion-paper-fold
title: Paper Fold Reveal
description: Nửa phải của tấm thiệp gập lật quanh nếp giữa (180°) về phía người xem, tối dần theo góc và đổ bóng lên trang dưới, để lộ nội dung bên trong; rồi gập lại.

moworks.author: takayu

options.closeAt: s after the start to fold back (null)
options.cover: the flap's front (on the right half)
options.back: the flap's back (laid over the left half)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-material-paper-fold, written here): Right half (80x96) folds about the centre crease toward the viewer: rotateY 0 → 180° (perspective 420) over 1.1 s power2.inOut at 0.4 s, back 2.6-3.6 s. Darken by angle, max 55 % (× sin); a cast shadow on the base page (45 % × sin). The front face shows the cover (accent, 'OPEN', foreshortened), the back face the inside content (bars); the base page holds the inner spread ('INSIDE' + lines). Params: angle (180°) · duration (1.1 s, power2.inOut) · darken (55 %) · shadow (45 %) · perspective (420). Folds toward the viewer about the centre crease; the faces swap at 90°, so neither reads mirrored.
